olmo3.description: Default since 2026-10-15. OLMo-3 7B base (Olmo-3-1025-7B) / Olmo-3-7B-Instruct (Ai2, 2025-26, Apache 2.0, fully open training data) as observer/performer: Binoculars AUC 0.83 and Fast-DetectGPT 0.76 on the 67 controls, the best current pair measured; Qwen3.5 small base models for the token statistics; 2026 ModernBERT classifier as one vote. No published thresholds, so no verdict line.

smollm3.description: Light set: SmolLM3-3B base/instruct (Hugging Face, 2025, Apache 2.0), about 13 GB with the Qwen3.5 small models. Binoculars AUC 0.81, Fast-DetectGPT 0.79, alignment imprint 0.90 on the 67 controls; nearly as good as olmo3 at a third of the download.

latest.description: All-Qwen3.5 set (2026). Its 9B pair is near chance for Binoculars / Fast-DetectGPT on the 67 controls (AUC 0.62 / 0.60); the small base models carry the strongest token statistics. Kept for comparison.

hybrid.description: Falcon-7B pair (2023; best measured pair for Binoculars / Fast-DetectGPT, AUC 0.80 / 0.79) with the Qwen3.5 small models. Kept for comparison; not the default because the Falcon models are 2023-era.

original.description: The Binoculars paper's reference pair and the thresholds derived for it (2023 models). Calibrated: reports state a Binoculars verdict. Select with --older-models.

falcon3.description: Bake-off candidate: Falcon3-7B base/instruct (2024, Apache 2.0) as observer/performer, with the default profile's small Qwen3.5 base models for token statistics. Uncalibrated.

dev.description: Development profile: small local models only, for fast iteration on the report. Not a detector recommendation.
